# API compatibility

Compatibility status of all 438 endpoints of upstream Misskey (the pinned version).

## Statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Compatible | Same parameters, errors, responses, and behavior as upstream |
| Differs | Implemented. Part of the behavior differs, for example because of Cloudflare constraints |
| Approximate | Implemented. Parts that depend on Redis or BullMQ are approximated |
| Not implemented | Not implemented (returns 501) |

## Categories

| Category | Policy |
|---|---|
| User-facing | Strictly compatible with upstream. Behavior in third-party clients is guaranteed |
| Admin-facing | Used only by the admin UI and moderators. Optimization and changes are allowed |

Endpoints whose names start with `admin/`, that require admin or moderator rights upstream, or that require an admin token permission are admin-facing.

## Endpoints that are not compatible

Everything above that is not "Compatible". Special routes outside endpoint-list (`/api/signup` and others) are included.

### User-facing

| Endpoint | Status | Difference |
|---|---|---|
| `antennas/notes` | Approximate | Stored in a Durable Object instead of Redis |
| `channels/timeline`<br>`notes/hybrid-timeline`<br>`notes/local-timeline`<br>`notes/timeline`<br>`notes/user-list-timeline`<br>`users/notes` | Approximate | PostgreSQL returns the same results instead of Redis. The length cap is not reproduced |
| `charts/active-users`<br>`charts/ap-request`<br>`charts/drive`<br>`charts/federation`<br>`charts/instance`<br>`charts/notes`<br>`charts/user/drive`<br>`charts/user/following`<br>`charts/user/notes`<br>`charts/user/pv`<br>`charts/user/reactions`<br>`charts/users` | Approximate | Computed from the source tables on request. Decrements and event-based series are 0 |
| `drive/files/create`<br>`drive/files/upload-from-url` | Differs | 100 MB limit. No automatic sensitive-media detection |
| `federation/instances` | Differs | Stats on existing deployments need recomputing |
| `fetch-rss` | Differs | The concurrency limit is per isolate |
| `gallery/featured`<br>`hashtags/trend`<br>`notes/featured`<br>`users/featured-notes` | Approximate | Ranking aggregated in PostgreSQL (approximate) |
| `i/delete-account`<br>`i/update-email`<br>`request-reset-password` | Differs | Sent through Cloudflare Email Service |
| `i/export-antennas`<br>`i/export-blocking`<br>`i/export-clips`<br>`i/export-favorites`<br>`i/export-following`<br>`i/export-mute`<br>`i/export-notes`<br>`i/export-user-lists` | Differs | Built in one job. Extremely large accounts depend on Worker limits |
| `i/move` | Differs | Split into step jobs. The target is checked by exact match |
| `meta` | Differs | Returns this fork's URL when repositoryUrl is unset |
| `notes/create` | Differs | Charts are not updated |
| `notes/drafts/create`<br>`notes/drafts/update` | Differs | Scheduled posting runs on a Durable Object alarm. Unscheduled on failure |
| `notes/reactions/create`<br>`notes/reactions/delete` | Differs | No reaction buffering |
| `server-info` | Differs | Machine information is fixed |
| `stats` | Approximate | Counts are current row counts |
| `chat/messages/create-to-user`<br>`chat/messages/create-to-room`<br>`chat/history` | Differs | Read state is tracked in a PostgreSQL column |
| `/api/signup`<br>`/api/signup-pending` | Differs | Refused before the initial setup |
